Bombay High Court Orders Maharashtra to Curb Neon Light Pollution

The Bombay High Court has directed the Maharashtra government to effectively implement a 1998 order banning neon and other high-intensity lights. The court was examining allegations of light pollution against Marine Drive gymkhanas. The directive aims to address concerns over light pollution.
